sections.text_helper: Section 28.7.4 "XSPI device configuration register 3 (XSPI_DCR3)" in chapter 28 (Extended-SPI interface (XSPI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1333.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x010
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
This register can be modified only when BUSY = 0.
Bits 31:21 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 20:16 CSBOUND[4:0]: NCS boundary
This bitfield enables the transaction boundary feature. When active, a minimum value of
three is recommended.
The NCS is released on each boundary of 2CSBOUND bytes.
0: NCS boundary disabled
Others: NCS boundary set to 2CSBOUND bytes
Bits 15:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 7:0 MAXTRAN[7:0]: Maximum transfer
This bitfield enables the communication regulation feature.
The NCS is released every MAXTRAN+1 clock cycles when the other XSPI request
the access to the bus.
0: Maximum communication disabled
Others: Maximum communication is set to (MAXTRAN + 1) bytes.
